items.html: And this is the secret of what is said in the Tikunim: that Yesod is Gevura, in the secret of Yitzhak, which is "Ketz Chai" [end of Life], for he takes to the left. And from here the Gevura afterwards spread in Malchut, in the Yesod, the point of Zion within her, as is known; and from here came there all those Gevurot. And this is the secret of what is said in Parashat Beshalach, page 170: that women's minds are light. And they did not say that they have no Daat at all; and the intention is that they have only half of the Daat, which is the coronet of Gevura. And in the verse "with the loathsome bread" the matter of the Gevura called light [Kal] is explained; see there. Also see Parashat Shelach, as mentioned.
